comparison.objective: Crack an egg, separate shell, and sort contents/shells; candidate screens finishing media.
comparison.physical_skill: Fracture and bimanual shell opening versus non-destructive size/orientation separation through apertures.
comparison.success_condition: Egg contents in bowl and shells in scrap tray versus media in receiver and all washers left intact in screen.
comparison.reason: Both separate mixed components, but the physical mechanism and tested manipulation are materially different.
